title: Sermons on Several Occasions
author: John Wesley
tradition_notes: Wesley was the founder of Methodism. His sermons form the doctrinal standards of Methodism and reflect his Arminian theology emphasising free grace, prevenient grace, and universal atonement.
source_edition: CCEL digitization; text from the 1872 standard edition
notes: 141 sermons across 5 series. Wesley died 1791 — text is public domain in all jurisdictions. ThML source from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library. CCEL permission confirmed 2026-04-01 (Quincy). Sermons are globally numbered (1–141) across series. The 1872 Wesleyan conference edition is the standard critical text.
